title: Assignment #5: A Small Web Site with CSS / My Biography
summary: Build a four-page personal portfolio (mybio.html, education.html, work.html, hobbies.html) with one external style sheet (mycss.css).
requirements: mybio.html is the home page and has a menu linking to the other pages, plus content.
All links from the home page navigate correctly.
education.html demonstrates inline/embedded CSS and includes a form.
work.html has a table formatted with the external style sheet.
hobbies.html includes at least 3 images and one image map.
Content means paragraph text roughly the size of a ~100-word paragraph.

criteria.name: HTML Elements & Properties and Correct Syntax
criteria.description: Uses the required HTML items with correct syntax: DOCTYPE, , , , <body>, <p>, <h1..h6>, <hr />, <br />, <b>/<strong>, <i>/<em>, <img />, <table>, <a href>, image map, feedback form, indentation & spacing, internal documentation, CSS. One mark deduction per HTML error.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.description: All items included with correct syntax.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.description: 1-3 items missing.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.description: 4-6 items missing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: 7-9 items missing.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.description: 10 or fewer items included.

criteria.how_to_check: Check each item across all pages; count missing items; subtract one mark per HTML syntax error.

criteria.name: Webpage Content
criteria.description: All four pages are present, working, and contain paragraph content; one style sheet is present.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.description: All pages contain content; four working pages and one style sheet.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.description: Most pages contain content; four working pages and one style sheet.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.description: Some pages contain content; three or more working pages.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: Few pages contain content; two or more working pages.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.description: No content; one or more working pages.

criteria.how_to_check:
A page 'contains content' if its

text totals roughly 80+ words.

criteria.name: Navigation
criteria.description: Links are consistent, easy to find and work; image/icon links enhance navigation.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.description: Links created with images and text; icons enhance navigation.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.description: Links consistent and easy to find; navigate back and forth.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.description: User may become confused; some links may not work.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: User may become lost; links missing or not working.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.description: Only one web page is found.

criteria.how_to_check: Every page should link to every other page with working, correctly-cased links.

criteria.name: Images
criteria.description: Images are small or optimised with height= and width=; every image has a descriptive alt.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.description: Small/optimised with height and width; descriptive alt on every image.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.description: Reasonably small; could add height/width; all images have descriptive alt.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.description: Reasonably small; most images have descriptive alt.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: Images large/slow; most images lack alt.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.description: Excessively large graphics; all images lack alt.

criteria.how_to_check: Check alt text, width/height attributes and file sizes for every .

criteria.name: Proper Spelling, Capitalization, Grammar, and Punctuation
criteria.description: Text is free of spelling, grammar, punctuation and capitalization mistakes.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.description: No mistakes.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.description: 1-2 mistakes.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.description: 3 mistakes.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: 4 mistakes.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.description: 5 or more mistakes.

criteria.how_to_check: Count distinct mistakes in the visible text of all pages.

notes: Server upload and Brightspace zip requirements cannot be verified from the files and are left to the instructor.
